children.label: Cylinder barrel
children.function: Guides the piston and contains cylinder pressure. Cooling fins transfer heat to the surrounding air.

children.label: Cylinder head
children.function: Closes the combustion chamber and carries the ports, valve seats, guides and spark plugs.

children.label: Floating piston pin
children.function: Joins the piston to the rod small end, allowing the rod to articulate as the crankshaft turns.

children.label: Piston-pin end plug - left
children.function: The aluminium end plug protects the cylinder wall from direct contact with the steel end of the floating pin.

children.label: Piston-pin end plug - right
children.function: The aluminium end plug protects the cylinder wall from direct contact with the steel end of the floating pin.

children.label: Piston
children.function: Receives combustion pressure. Its skirt guides travel, and its grooves locate the rings that seal gases and control oil.

children.label: Top compression ring
children.function: Helps seal combustion gases and transfer heat from the piston to the cylinder barrel.

children.label: Second compression ring
children.function: Assists gas sealing below the top ring and helps control oil along the cylinder wall.

children.label: Slotted oil-control ring
children.function: Meters oil on the cylinder wall and provides drainage paths for excess oil through its slots.

children.label: Lower oil-scraper ring
children.function: Helps remove excess oil from the lower cylinder wall. This four-ring allocation remains a reconstruction.

children.label: Crankshaft throw
children.function: Receives connecting-rod force and turns it into rotary output. This model shows one simplified throw of the complete crankshaft.

children.label: Connecting rod
children.function: Transfers piston loads to the crankpin while changing angle as the crankshaft rotates.

children.label: Connecting-rod cap
children.function: Closes the rod big end around the crankpin, allowing assembly and removal of the connecting rod.

children.label: Rod bearing - upper half
children.function: Provides a replaceable, lubricated running surface between the connecting rod and the rotating crankpin.

children.label: Rod bearing - cap half
children.function: Completes the crankpin bearing inside the cap and transfers bearing loads into the connecting rod.

children.label: Connecting-rod bolt A
children.function: Clamps the cap to the rod and maintains the big-end joint under alternating engine loads.

children.label: Slotted rod nut A
children.function: Retains bolt clamping force at the rod-cap joint. The slots accommodate the locking arrangement; cotter pins are not modelled.

children.label: Connecting-rod bolt B
children.function: Clamps the cap to the rod and maintains the big-end joint under alternating engine loads.

children.label: Slotted rod nut B
children.function: Retains bolt clamping force at the rod-cap joint. The slots accommodate the locking arrangement; cotter pins are not modelled.

children.label: Small-end bushing
children.function: Supports the floating piston pin in the rod and provides a replaceable surface for relative movement.

children.label: Intake valve seat
children.function: Provides the closed valve with a durable sealing surface and conducts heat from the valve into the cylinder head.

children.label: Intake valve
children.function: Opens to admit the incoming air-fuel charge, then closes to seal the cylinder during compression and expansion.

children.label: Intake valve guide
children.function: Keeps the sliding valve stem aligned with its seat while transferring heat into the surrounding head.

children.label: Intake inner valve spring
children.function: Adds valve-closing force and works with the outer spring to help control valve motion.

children.label: Intake outer valve spring
children.function: Supplies force to return the valve to its seat and maintain contact through the valve-operating mechanism.

children.label: Intake spring retainer
children.function: Transfers spring force to the valve through the tapered keepers and retains the spring ends.

children.label: Intake valve keepers
children.function: Engage the valve-stem groove and lock the spring retainer to the stem. The split keys are represented by a sleeve envelope.

children.label: Intake rocker shaft
children.function: Supports the rocker arm and establishes the pivot axis for transmitting pushrod motion to the valve.

children.label: Intake rocker arm
children.function: Pivots around its shaft to convert pushrod motion into valve opening. Oil passages supply lubrication to the valve gear.

children.label: Intake rocker housing
children.function: Supports and encloses the rocker mechanism. It is separately selectable here to help inspect the reconstructed head assembly.

children.label: Intake rocker-cover gasket
children.function: Seals the cover joint to help retain lubricating oil inside the rocker enclosure.

children.label: Intake rocker cover
children.function: The stamped steel cover retains oil and shields the rocker mechanism from external contamination.

children.label: Intake pushrod
children.function: Transfers lifter motion to the rocker. Its hollow centre carries lubricating oil to the rocker assembly.

children.label: Intake pushrod housing
children.function: Encloses the pushrod and provides a return path for oil draining from the rocker area to the crankcase.

children.label: Intake housing seal - crankcase
children.function: Seals the pushrod-housing joint to retain returning oil and limit leakage.

children.label: Intake housing seal - cylinder
children.function: Seals the pushrod-housing joint to retain returning oil and limit leakage.

children.label: Intake hydraulic tappet body
children.function: Carries cam motion toward the pushrod. The complete hydraulic tappet compensates for operating clearance; only its outer body is modelled.

children.label: Exhaust valve seat
children.function: Provides the closed valve with a durable sealing surface and conducts heat from the valve into the cylinder head.

children.label: Exhaust valve
children.function: Opens to discharge combustion gases, then closes to seal the chamber for the next cycle.

children.label: Exhaust valve guide
children.function: Keeps the sliding valve stem aligned with its seat while transferring heat into the surrounding head.

children.label: Exhaust inner valve spring
children.function: Adds valve-closing force and works with the outer spring to help control valve motion.

children.label: Exhaust outer valve spring
children.function: Supplies force to return the valve to its seat and maintain contact through the valve-operating mechanism.

children.label: Exhaust rotocoil retainer
children.function: Retains the exhaust springs. The rotocoil promotes small valve rotations to distribute heat and wear; its internals are not modelled.

children.label: Exhaust valve keepers
children.function: Engage the valve-stem groove and lock the spring retainer to the stem. The split keys are represented by a sleeve envelope.

children.label: Exhaust rocker shaft
children.function: Supports the rocker arm and establishes the pivot axis for transmitting pushrod motion to the valve.

children.label: Exhaust rocker arm
children.function: Pivots around its shaft to convert pushrod motion into valve opening. Oil passages supply lubrication to the valve gear.

children.label: Exhaust rocker housing
children.function: Supports and encloses the rocker mechanism. It is separately selectable here to help inspect the reconstructed head assembly.

children.label: Exhaust rocker-cover gasket
children.function: Seals the cover joint to help retain lubricating oil inside the rocker enclosure.

children.label: Exhaust rocker cover
children.function: The stamped steel cover retains oil and shields the rocker mechanism from external contamination.

children.label: Exhaust pushrod
children.function: Transfers lifter motion to the rocker. Its hollow centre carries lubricating oil to the rocker assembly.

children.label: Exhaust pushrod housing
children.function: Encloses the pushrod and provides a return path for oil draining from the rocker area to the crankcase.

children.label: Exhaust housing seal - crankcase
children.function: Seals the pushrod-housing joint to retain returning oil and limit leakage.

children.label: Exhaust housing seal - cylinder
children.function: Seals the pushrod-housing joint to retain returning oil and limit leakage.

children.label: Exhaust hydraulic tappet body
children.function: Carries cam motion toward the pushrod. The complete hydraulic tappet compensates for operating clearance; only its outer body is modelled.

children.label: Upper spark-plug shell
children.function: Locates the spark plug in the cylinder head and provides a grounded metal body. Electrode detail is simplified.

children.label: Upper spark-plug insulator
children.function: Electrically isolates the central high-voltage path from the grounded metal shell. Its external ribs lengthen the surface leakage path.

children.label: Upper spark-plug terminal
children.function: Connects the ignition lead to the spark plug so a timed high-voltage pulse can reach the central electrode.

children.label: Lower spark-plug shell
children.function: Locates the spark plug in the cylinder head and provides a grounded metal body. Electrode detail is simplified.

children.label: Lower spark-plug insulator
children.function: Electrically isolates the central high-voltage path from the grounded metal shell. Its external ribs lengthen the surface leakage path.

children.label: Lower spark-plug terminal
children.function: Connects the ignition lead to the spark plug so a timed high-voltage pulse can reach the central electrode.
